person.description: Index into persons[]. The filer this Form 1099-MISC was issued to — the primary, or the spouse on a joint return.

royalties_cents.description: Box 2, royalties. Optional: absent means this form's box 2 is blank. Every 1099-MISC's box 2 on the return is summed into the one return-level royalty activity (the dictionary models royalties as a single activity, not one per form) — the ordinary expenses and the oil/gas/geothermal classification are asked once, at the root (`royalty_expenses_cents`, `royalty_is_oil_gas_geothermal`), never on this form. Reaches Schedule E line 4 and, through Schedule 1 line 5 and Form 1040 line 8, line 9. Never negative.

other_income_cents.description: Box 3, other income — the only 1099-MISC box the engine holds at the pin besides box 2 (rents and the medical and other boxes are not covered). Required: the form is issued because an amount was paid, so a blank box is an unread box. Reaches Schedule 1 line 8z (line 8g when it is an Alaska Permanent Fund dividend) and, through Schedule 1 line 10 and Form 1040 line 8, line 9. Never negative.

is_alaska_pfd.description: Whether box 3 of this form is an Alaska Permanent Fund dividend — the engine's own question on every 1099-MISC, whose unanswered default reads true. Required once box 3 (`other_income_cents`) is above 0: a $0 box has nothing to classify, so the answer is supplied automatically as false and never asked. Reconciled with the return's Alaska Permanent Fund dividend answers: a yes there needs a form marked here for that person, and a form marked here needs a yes there; each contradiction is refused by name.

federal_withholding_cents.description: Box 4, federal income tax withheld. Optional: blank is an ordinary state of the box; absent is computed as zero and stated in the response. Reaches Form 1040 line 25b, inside line 25d. Never negative.
